data.action: 只穿轻薄抹胸坐在床沿，指尖跃动微弱熔岩火光，脸颊泛红，恶魔长尾轻卷足踝，眼神迷离娇羞
data.description: 深夜私密卧房的大床上，只穿轻薄抹胸的莱瓦汀坐在床沿，微弱的熔岩火光在修长的指尖跳跃明灭。被源石热力蒸得通红的雪白肌肤散发着惊人的温度，她一把抓住你的领口——「身体里像是有火在烧……光靠冰淇淋可降不下这种温度。管理员……今晚由你来负责熄灭我心头的狂热！」
data.lighting: 舱内柔和淡蓝环境光与床头暖灯，白嫩肌肤泛着微热红晕
data.location: 塔罗斯研究舰单人休息舱
data.nsfwProse: She wears only a minimal lightweight bandeau wrap across her chest and matching briefs, leaving her heated shoulders, midriff, and bare legs exposed on the bed edge.
data.promptProse: Seated barefoot on the edge of her private research-ship bunk late at night wearing only a minimal lightweight bandeau, Laevatain curls her long demon tail loosely around one ankle. While a tiny dancing orange ember hovers above her open fingertips, her other hand tugs firmly on her partner's collar with heavily flushed cheeks and breathless heat as warm flame and bedside lamplight contrast with the cabin's cool blue ambient glow.
data.title: 莱瓦汀 · 舱室余烬·温热龙尾与床榻足尖
data.animaCaption: Seated barefoot on the cabin bed edge in only a lightweight bandeau with her tail coiled near her ankle, Laevatain balances a tiny ember over one palm while tugging her partner's collar with the other. Warm flame light highlights her flushed skin against cool blue cabin light.
